    ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.numerator n t * t * (t + 2 * ↑n + 1)

∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (t : ℚ),
      (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.actualR n t * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapKernelBridge.aValue n t =
          ↑n.factorial ^ 7 * Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n) /
            Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial (n - 1)) ^ 9

∀ (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Even n) (b : Fin 5 → ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL n (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapKernelBridge.inverseMultiplier n hn2 hn b) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapKernelBridge.prescribedL b

records.definitionValue: fun n hn2 hn => LinearEquiv.ofBijective (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.quarticAggregateLinearMap n) ⋯
records.type: (n : ℕ) → 2 ≤ n → Even n → (Fin 5 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] Fin 5 → ℚ

∀ (b : Fin 5 → ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapKernelBridge.prescribedL b =
    ↑(b 0) +
      (↑(b 1) * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal 3 + ↑(b 2) * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal 5 +
          ↑(b 3) * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal 7 +
        ↑(b 4) * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal 9)

∀ (n n_1 : ℕ) (e_n : n = n_1) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Even n) (b b_1 : Fin 5 → ℚ),
  b = b_1 →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapKernelBridge.inverseMultiplier n hn2 hn b =
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapKernelBridge.inverseMultiplier n_1 ⋯ ⋯ b_1

∀ (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Even n) (b : Fin 5 → ℚ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  W.natDegree ≤ 4 →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = b →
      W = ZetaNine.CoefficientMapKernelBridge.inverseMultiplier n hn2 hn b

∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (W H : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator n W =
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n * H →
        ∀ (t : ℚ),
          (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoper n W t =
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.actualR n t * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapKernelBridge.aValue n t *
                  Polynomial.eval t H /
                ↑n.factorial ^ 7
ℕ → ℚ → ℚ

∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W H : ℚ[X]),
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapAggregate.aggregate n W = 0 →
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.telescoperNumerator n W =
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapTelescoper.rootPolynomial n * H →
              Polynomial.C (↑n.factorial ^ 7) * W.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.baseU n) =
                (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (↑n + 1)) * (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑n) ^ 10 * H -
                  Polynomial.X ^ 10 * (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (2 * ↑n + 1)) *
                    H.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C 1)
